description_en: Queries the details of a network instance (VPC, VBR, or CCN) attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the attachment status and network instance type
description_zh: 调用DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribute接口查看加载到CEN中的网络实例（VPC、VBR、CCN）的网络实例的加载状态、网络实例的类型等详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-attached-child-instance-attribute --cen-id cen-5mv960yjhja0dh0000 --child-instance-id vpc-2zebdboka7d7t37vo0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the network instance loaded to the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例已加载的网络实例ID。
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

VBR: virtual border router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型，取值：

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

CCN：云连接网实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.                   

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。                   

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id
